correctness.rationale: The forced-root choice removes exactly one forest edge; merging can only destroy singleton branches, and a positive-probability all-to-first-vertex construction makes every local influence strictly positive. Ewens singleton deletion gives the exact leading term, uniform-parent symmetry gives the rigorous upper remainder, factorial-moment Bonferroni bounds give lambda_N -> exp(-theta), and harmonic summation yields the global covariance. Independent exact-rational enumeration passed 210 assertions.

value.rationale: For protected-root resilience, neither mean total leaves nor mean total degree resolves which labeled attachment decisions matter. The theorem gives strict negative sign for every decision, finite parameter-dependent bounds and a universal late-arrival influence scale whose accumulation yields a nonzero limiting covariance, including an entire root-weight family.
